title: Amazing
subtitle: amazing = 令人驚訝的；令人驚嘆的；非常出色的

words.meaning: 令人震驚的；令人十分驚訝的
words.note: 表示事情非常出乎意料，令人難以相信或一時反應不過來。比一般的 surprising 強得多。
words.example: The scientists made an astonishing discovery beneath the ice.

exercises.original: The team made an amazing recovery in the final ten minutes.
exercises.zh: 球隊在最後十分鐘出現了令人震驚的反彈。
exercises.upgrade: astonishing · 令人震驚的；令人十分驚訝的

options.explanation: ordinary = 普通的。和「令人驚嘆」意思相反。
astonishing = 本題最準確的選擇，符合句子要表達的語境和語氣。
pleasant = 令人愉快的。只表示感受舒服，不足以表達強烈驚嘆。
famous = 著名的。知名度不等於令人驚嘆。
formal = 正式的。描述風格或場合，不表示驚人。
interesting = 有趣的。能引起興趣不等於令人震撼。

falseSynonyms.zh: 令人意外不等於令人驚嘆 surprising 只表示出乎意料；amazing 往往還包含強烈讚賞、震撼或難以置信。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Something can be surprising without being impressive. Something amazing often causes stronger wonder or admiration.

falseSynonyms.zh: 令人佩服不一定等於令人驚訝 impressive 強調值得佩服；它不一定出乎意料。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An impressive performance earns admiration. An astonishing performance also strongly surprises you.

falseSynonyms.zh: 漂亮不等於驚人 beautiful 只強調美感；amazing 可以形容發現、結果、速度、能力等，範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A view can be beautiful and amazing, but an amazing discovery is not necessarily beautiful.

falseSynonyms.zh: 震驚不一定是正面的驚嘆 shocking 常帶負面、令人不安或冒犯的意味，而 amazing 很多時是正面的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Shocking news is often disturbing. Amazing news is often exciting or impressive.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有趣不等於驚人 interesting 表示能引起注意或好奇，但不一定特別出色或令人震撼。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An interesting idea holds your attention. An amazing idea may feel unusually impressive or original.

falseSynonyms.zh: 成功不等於驚人 successful 描述是否達到目標；成功的結果可以很普通，也可以很驚人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A project can be successful without being remarkable. Phenomenal success is success on an unusually impressive scale.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有名不等於驚人 famous 表示很多人知道；知名度和品質、震撼程度不是同一回事。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A famous place is widely known. A spectacular place creates a dramatic impression.

falseSynonyms.zh: 感到驚訝與令人驚訝不同 amazed 形容人的感受；amazing 形容令人產生這種感受的人或事物。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I was amazed by the view. The view was amazing.
